Change an upstream of a proxy repository

Change an upstream; only the flags given change. Its URL cannot change: remove it
and add another.

An upstream decides what the repository serves: a package it does not hold is
fetched from the upstreams in their order. Adding or changing one changes your
supply chain, so rp asks for confirmation on a terminal. In a script pass
--yes; with --no-input or without a terminal, and no --yes, the command exits 2
and changes nothing.

```
rp proxy update <repo> <id> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --active             Use the upstream (false keeps it but skips it) (default true)
      --password-stdin     Read the upstream's password from the first line of stdin
      --private            The upstream needs credentials (--username, --password-stdin)
      --timeout duration   Connection timeout, whole seconds, such as 30s
      --tls-check          Check the upstream's certificate (default true)
      --username string    Username for the upstream
```
